name: mandate
description: A consent rail for generative media: no likeness or voice renders until the depicted person's own agent has published a live, signed grant.

scripts.nodes:init: python3 spikes/drive-init.py ~/.dkg-mandate-grantor mandate-grantor 9201 && python3 spikes/drive-init.py ~/.dkg-mandate-producer mandate-producer 9202
scripts.nodes:start: DKG_HOME=~/.dkg-mandate-grantor node node_modules/@origintrail-official/dkg/dist/cli.js start && DKG_HOME=~/.dkg-mandate-producer node node_modules/@origintrail-official/dkg/dist/cli.js start
